defense_in_depth_findings.title: Concurrent-attempt loser exits via uncaught FileExistsError rather than the structured FAIL_CLOSED reporter
defense_in_depth_findings.evidence: scripts/research/f017_representative_ffn_composition_release_wrapper_v1.py: begin_attempt uses os.mkdir as the exclusive gate; a race loser raises FileExistsError, which is absent from the __main__ fail-closed catch tuple (ReleaseError, FileNotFoundError, PermissionError, CalledProcessError), so the loser terminates with a raw traceback and exit code 1 instead of the FAIL_CLOSED JSON and exit code 2. Independently verified with an 8-process synthetic race in a temporary HOME: exactly one winner (exit 0), seven losers (nonzero exit), losers performed zero FFN work and wrote zero state, and the winner's state reconciled to INTERRUPTED_AFTER_ATTEMPT_START_BEFORE_FFN with release_consumed true and ffn_compositions 0. The committed rehearsal race_worker explicitly catches FileExistsError, confirming the path is anticipated. Safety, exclusivity, accounting, and authority are unaffected; only loser-side reporting cleanliness differs.
defense_in_depth_findings.repair_requirement: NON_BLOCKING: in a future wrapper revision, add FileExistsError to the __main__ fail-closed handler so a race loser emits the structured FAIL_CLOSED packet. No change may be made to the reviewed bytes for this release.

defense_in_depth_findings.title: Release validator invoked at preflight without a runtime hash pin on its own bytes
defense_in_depth_findings.evidence: scripts/research/f017_representative_ffn_composition_release_wrapper_v1.py preflight() runs VALIDATOR via subprocess without first requiring sha256(VALIDATOR) to equal the release binding ea457fe02f4a5bb03d3aa1c96c1ad941fc1dcfaf3f8e27d8cadd9bc205d884be; the validator's repo-mode check of its own binding (line 92-93) is self-referential for that one file. Every load-bearing identity the validator checks is independently and redundantly pinned: the wrapper pins authorization, arithmetic, both reuse authorizations, and executor hashes as internal constants and hash-verifies the executor before import; the executor re-pins arithmetic, reuse, and both real input hashes; the token and approval bind the exact release bytes; attempt-start durably records wrapper_sha256 for grading; and the release contract binds validator and test bytes for operator/grader verification at the pinned code head. A same-user attacker able to tamper the validator at execution time could equally tamper the wrapper, so a runtime self-pin adds no authority beyond the committed-bytes-at-code-head discipline the release already mandates.
defense_in_depth_findings.repair_requirement: NON_BLOCKING: a future revision may hash-pin VALIDATOR bytes in the wrapper before subprocess invocation and record the validator sha in attempt-start, for audit symmetry.

defense_in_depth_findings.title: INPUT_FILESYSTEM_IDENTITY preflight gate is vacuous
defense_in_depth_findings.evidence: scripts/research/f017_representative_ffn_composition_release_wrapper_v1.py line 413: require(routed_stat.st_dev != 0 and shared_stat.st_dev != 0) is always true on Darwin, so the gate cannot fail. Actual input identity and integrity are enforced elsewhere and were adversarially verified: owner, single-link, read-only, regular-file, exact-size checks at open; manifest sha binding; expected==before==consumed==after sha256 equality on the same file descriptor and inode; symlink, multi-link, writable, truncated, substituted, and path-traversal inputs all rejected in synthetic probes.
defense_in_depth_findings.repair_requirement: NON_BLOCKING: a future revision may replace the check with a meaningful device-identity assertion (for example, comparing input root st_dev against an expected volume) or remove the misleading label.

defense_in_depth_findings.title: Audit hashes of approval and go-token are re-read from disk at attempt-start rather than reused from the validated bytes
defense_in_depth_findings.evidence: begin_attempt records approval_sha256 and go_token_sha256 via sha256_path after authorize() already validated those files, leaving a narrow same-user TOCTOU window in which the recorded audit hash could differ from the validated bytes. Authority is unaffected: authorization decisions were made from the validated bytes, the token must exactly equal an eight-field object binding the live release hash, and any substitution before validation fails closed (verified: forged approvals with extra keys, REJECT verdicts, and stale release_sha256 were all rejected; a token is compared by exact dict equality so any added or altered field fails).
defense_in_depth_findings.repair_requirement: NON_BLOCKING: a future revision may thread the validated raw bytes from authorize() into begin_attempt so the recorded audit hashes are provably the validated ones.

tests_and_mutations.note: All tests and probes were checkpoint-free, used synthetic bytes in temporary directories with a synthetic HOME, and never touched the real retained tensors, real state roots, real approval path, or any checkpoint or shard. No GO token was constructed; only forged or placeholder authority files exercising rejection paths.

concurrency_disposition: PASS. Exclusive attempt creation rests on atomic os.mkdir of the fixed attempt-state root; preflight additionally requires the root absent. In an 8-process race exactly one process created the root and wrote the durable attempt-start; all losers performed zero FFN work and wrote no state. State records are published with O_EXCL temporaries and no-replace hard links, so no concurrent writer can replace a record. The committed two-process rehearsal case agrees. Loser-side error reporting is the only roughness (DID-1, non-blocking).
durability_disposition: PASS. Attempt-start: mkdir of state root, fsync of its parent directory, then an fsynced no-replace record before any FFN arithmetic, so consumption is durable before computation. FFN-start: a second durable record before arithmetic whose presence alone counts one composition regardless of outcome. Output and manifest: opened-once validated 0700 directory descriptor, absence checks for both destinations, O_EXCL hidden temporary, full write, file fsync, fchmod 0400, file fsync, no-replace hard link relative to the same descriptor, directory fsync, temp unlink, directory fsync, then descriptor read-back byte comparison; sequence matches the publication contract exactly. Receipt and terminal use the same publish primitive in the state root. Every crash window (before mkdir; after mkdir before attempt-start; after attempt-start; after ffn-start; after publication; after receipt; before terminal; forged terminal) maps to a deterministic read-only terminalizer disposition, verified by the committed rehearsal and independent probes; output authority exists only with matching output, manifest, receipt, and COMPLETE terminal.
numerical_surface_disposition: PASS. The only composition path is compose_bytes: struct.unpack of 6144 little-endian f64 and 6144 little-endian f32 (promotion to binary64 is exact at unpack), one scalar binary64 addition per coordinate in increasing order 0..6143 with hardware round-to-nearest ties-to-even, repacked contiguous little-endian binary64. No reduction, no BLAS, no GPU, no parallel arithmetic, no numpy; thread variables pinned to 1 and CPython 3.14.6 Darwin arm64 enforced. Independently verified coordinate-exact equality on a 6144-coordinate synthetic case. Non-finite inputs and outputs fail closed (the output finiteness check is unreachable for finite inputs since max-finite f32 is below one ulp of max-finite f64 - harmless defense in depth). Production serial-f32 has no code path, is declared a separate unauthorized surface, and reclassification mutations are rejected by validator and tests.
input_authority_disposition: PASS. Consume-what-you-validated holds structurally: OpenInput reads the artifact bytes once through an O_NOFOLLOW descriptor after owner, regular-file, single-link, read-only, and exact-size checks, hash-verifies them against the authorization binding, and compose_from_open_inputs composes from that same immutable bytes object; verify_after re-reads through the same descriptor and requires expected == before == consumed == after with unchanged device and inode. The private manifests are hash-bound and field-bound to the artifacts. Both retained input identities (routed f64 49152 bytes, shared f32 24576 bytes) are pinned identically in the executor constants, the authorization contract, and the release. All seven tampering probes were rejected.
approval_separation_disposition: PASS. The release is bytes-pinned but inert: status PREPARED_FOR_INDEPENDENT_APPROVAL, real_event_authorized false, approval_asserted false, and the wrapper requires exactly those values even in execute mode, so the release can never become its own authority. Execution additionally requires a separate committed approval at a fixed repository path with an exact fourteen-key census, verdict ACCEPT, the exact approval statement, approval_does_not_execute true, approval_is_not_token true, real_event_authorized false, and a binding to the live release bytes; plus a GO token at a fixed machine-local path equal by exact dict comparison to eight fields binding approval sha, release sha, authorization sha, ids, and disposition GO_EXECUTE_ONCE_NO_RETRY - the token is the sole artifact asserting real_event_authorized true. Preflight-only mode forbids a token argument. No approval artifact for this release and no GO token exists anywhere in the repository; forged-approval and forged-token probes all failed closed.

operator_readiness_answer: YES. The committed release package is sufficient for a separate operator execution decision without approving or executing anything now: it pins the exact code head, all fourteen artifact identities, both retained input authorities, the exact numerical surface, fixed non-caller-selectable paths, the exact approval key census and statement, the exact eight-field GO token schema, deterministic crash reconciliation via the bound read-only terminalizer, and independently gradable output authority conditions. Nothing in the package asserts approval, creates a token, or performs the composition; the operator's decision remains a genuinely separate, subsequent act.
statement: I independently reviewed the committed representative FFN composition single-use release package at head 0c8e9248dc6da940d0814f1d4452fba63624c546 against the committed review request, recomputing every hash from repository bytes, tracing every producer and consumer, running the committed checkpoint-free validator, tests, and rehearsal (the rehearsal regenerated byte-identically), and executing my own synthetic races, forgeries, tamperings, and arithmetic checks in isolated temporary directories. No blocking or non-blocking-required findings exist; four defense-in-depth observations are documented with evidence and non-blocking dispositions. The release binds exactly the accepted proof-reference authorization and both retained input authorities, fails closed on every identity, admits at most one attempt with durable consumption before computation, accounts truthfully for exactly one future FFN composition, publishes durably with no-replace semantics and terminal-gated authority, contains no checkpoint, shard, expert, S1, or S2 capability, and is ready for a separate independent operator approval and execution decision. Verdict: ACCEPT.
